review: Reviewed Sol's round-41 request (moss bedding trial) and the accepted world-69 develop review (learning 3): a general arrange-resting-material operation with arrange, inspect, trial-rest, remove, resume and cancel, admitting only loose moss for ground placement, with no thickness, coverage, comfort or facility effect. Every required mechanism already exists, so no new physical rule was needed. Implemented arrange-resting-material@1 in scope long-ex14, following the ex13 moss-resting-pad-trial@1 design. Arrange takes owned moss in 0.1 steps (default 0.5) and an unoccupied ordinary-ground site in reach; it runs two paid work rounds of one energy each with exact escrow and moves the reserved material into a persistent patch with a 0.25-radius footprint used only for occupancy and drawing. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) records visible placement, remaining quantity, occupancy and tests as a personal unverified record. Trial-rest requires standing on a completed, unoccupied patch and runs the existing baseline rest handler unchanged, recording energy before and after; the patch is not registered as a facility, so it adds no bonus. Remove (the arranger only, unoccupied patch, one round, one energy) returns the remaining material as an owned stack at the site and deletes the patch; pickup stays separate. Cancel releases reserved material once and death releases it on the ground; spent effort is never refunded; no decay, contamination, regrowth, repair or reward rule is added. Reuse is recorded: collective-work escrow, portions and paid work, the tray-placement site check, the forest baseline rest handler and personal records. Tests cover paid arranging, conservation, rejection of other materials, rest equal to ordinary rest, unverified inspection and arranger-only removal in place.
